mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT ast33_fund_trans.* , f_cdnm('FundTransCode', ast33_fund_trans_cd, ast33_company_id, ast33_date) as ast33_fund_trans_nm , CASE WHEN ast33_company_id = 1 THEN sys15_corp_cd ELSE sys01_icam_company_cd END as ast33_corp_cd , CASE WHEN ast33_company_id = 1 THEN sys15_corp_nm ELSE sys01_company_nm END as ast33_corp_nm , ( SELECT ast30_fund_nm FROM ast30_book_fund_fee WHERE ast30_corp_id = ast33_corp_id AND ast30_fund_cd = ast33_fund_cd ORDER BY ast30_hold_date LIMIT 1 ) as ast33_fund_nm , act02_journal_id as ast33_journal_id FROM ast33_fund_trans INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = ast33_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast33_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) tr ON ast06_tr_id = ast33_tr_id WHERE ast33_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast33_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND ast33_fund_trans_cd LIKE #{fundTransCode} ) t WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(ast33_corp_cd, ast33_corp_nm, ast33_fund_cd, ast33_fund_nm, ast33_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY ast33_date, ast33_fund_trans_id

SELECT FROM ( SELECT ast33_fund_trans.* , f_cdnm('FundTransCode', ast33_fund_trans_cd, ast33_company_id, ast33_date) as ast33_fund_trans_nm , CASE WHEN ast33_company_id = 1 THEN sys15_corp_cd ELSE sys01_icam_company_cd END as ast33_corp_cd , CASE WHEN ast33_company_id = 1 THEN sys15_corp_nm ELSE sys01_company_nm END as ast33_corp_nm , ( SELECT ast30_fund_nm FROM ast30_book_fund_fee WHERE ast30_company_id = ast33_company_id AND ast30_corp_id = ast33_corp_id AND ast30_fund_cd = ast33_fund_cd ORDER BY ast30_hold_date LIMIT 1 ) as ast33_fund_nm , act02_journal_id as ast33_journal_id FROM ast33_fund_trans INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = ast33_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast33_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) tr ON ast06_tr_id = ast33_tr_id WHERE ast33_fund_trans_id = #{fundTransId} AND ast33_company_id = #{companyId} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast33_fund_trans (ast33_fund_trans_id, ast33_company_id, ast33_fund_trans_cd, ast33_date, ast33_corp_id, ast33_fund_cd, ast33_fee, ast33_for_fee, ast33_cur_cd, ast33_note, ast33_tr_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{r.fundTransCode}, #{r.date}, #{r.corpId}, #{r.fundCode}, #{r.fee}, #{r.forFee}, #{r.curCode}, #{r.note}, #{r.trId})
